director.query: What does memory know about the selected director persona Kathryn Bigelow (kathryn_bigelow) for this Embry/Kai surf story? Return matching persona and persona_memory records. Story: Embry’s phone buzzes on the beach bag like obligation had learned echolocation. Ten yards out, a clean June lump lifts over the dark lava reef; glare turns the face silver, and her older white shortboard’s softened wax lets one palm skid. Kai, outside on his familiar board, doesn’t call her in. He waits, trims aside for a local, then points two fingers at the safe channel. Embry resets her rail grip, saves three tired strokes, and chooses the wave.
